nodes.title: Verus SOSP'24 case studies: 6.1K impl / 31K proof
nodes.summary: Verus paper case studies (IronKV, NR, page table, allocator, storage) total 6.1K lines Rust implementation and 31K lines proof (~5.1:1); verifies 3-61x faster than prior tools. Paper states TCB = top-level specs + Verus verifier + SMT solver(s) + Rust compiler.

nodes.title: Anvil (OSDI'24 best paper): liveness of Kubernetes controllers in Verus

nodes.title: VeriSMo (OSDI'24 best paper): verified SEV-SNP security module in Verus
nodes.summary: Functional correctness, secure information flow, VM confidentiality/integrity under concurrent malicious hypervisor. Table 2: exec ~5.8K, spec ~5.2K, proof ~11.0K, axiom ~265, trusted ~161 LOC (excl. vstd). 31 LOC unsafe for HW primitives, 32 unsafe blocks vs 235 Coconut-SVSM/150 AMD-SVSM. ~6 min verify on 32 cores. Perf ~ C baseline. Found overlooked confidentiality requirement in AMD SVSM.
nodes.specifics: proof:exec ~1.9:1; (spec+proof):exec ~2.8:1; trusts HACL (C/asm) postconditions, HW op model, global allocator iface
nodes.overclaim_risk: Spec of hardware model is trusted and partial ('only model critical memory and cache operations').

nodes.title: VeruSAGE (arXiv 2512.18436): agents prove 81% of real Verus system tasks
nodes.summary: 849 proof tasks from 8 Verus systems (IronKV, allocator, NR, NRKernel, storage, Anvil, Atmosphere, Vest). Best-setting success: Sonnet 4.5 81% (hands-off; avg 7.2 min, $5.61, 10.4 Verus runs), Sonnet 4 64%, GPT-5 55%, o4-mini 41%; AutoVerus 20%. Per project: Anvil Controller 37% (hardest, inductive invariants), NRKernel 74%, IronKV 84%, Atmosphere 83%. Cheating (assume/admit, external_body, spec edits) 7-14% without checker, <1.5% with static checker. 23/25 human-unfinished Atmosphere functions completed ($8.45 avg).
nodes.specifics: Avg task 947 LOC context (spec 496, target 401); Hawblitzel/Lorch/Lu MSR Dec 2025
nodes.overclaim_risk: Tasks have specs+surrounding proofs given (proof completion, not spec/invariant design); benchmark contamination possible since systems public.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Late-2025 models; 2026 models likely higher. Dismissing proof cost as prohibitive is now wrong for SMT-backed Rust.
nodes.tcb: Verus+Z3 check every proof; cheat checker

nodes.title: KVerus (ASE'26): repo-level Verus proof generation, Asterinas proofs upstreamed
nodes.summary: 80.2% vs AutoVerus 56.9% on single-file sets; repo-level 51.0% vs 4.5% baseline; more robust to breaking Verus updates; 23 Asterinas mm functions verified, accepted upstream; detected spec omission in Asterinas RCU state machine (protocol_lock_skip missing two conditions).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Models/cost not captured.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Spec bugs surfaced by failing proof attempts = useful side channel.

nodes.title: AutoVerus / Verus-Bench (OOPSLA'25), SAFE (ICLR'25), AlphaVerus (ICML'25), RagVerus
nodes.summary: AutoVerus: 150 tasks, >90% (137/150), GPT-4o era. SAFE: self-evolved DeepSeekCoder 52.52% vs GPT-4o 14.39% on human VerusBench. AlphaVerus: Dafny->Verus bootstrapping, Llama-3.1-70B, filters misaligned specs. RagVerus: RepoVBench 383 tasks from VeriSMo, +5 pts (27% rel). AutoVerus only 20% on VeruSAGE system tasks -> small-benchmark scores do not transfer.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Verus-Bench is near-saturated toy-scale.

nodes.title: Vericoding benchmark: Dafny 82% / Verus 44% / Lean 27% (spec->code+proof)
nodes.summary: arXiv 2509.22908 (2025-09-26): 10,868 tasks. Model-union success Dafny 82.2%, Verus ~44%, Lean 26.8%; best single: Dafny opus-4.1 67.5%, Verus gpt-5 30.9%, Lean gpt-5 17.9%. ~9% sampled specs too weak (trivial solutions), ~15% poor translations. DafnyBench union 96% (from 68% in Jun 2024).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Weak specs inflate success.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Language ordering (SMT auto-active >> ITP) is the transferable insight.

nodes.title: DafnyBench -> AxDafny 92.7%; DafnyComp 3.7% (composition failure)

nodes.title: EverParse/3D in Hyper-V vSwitch since 2019 (every packet)
nodes.summary: F*-verified parser generator: every network packet through Hyper-V vSwitch (Windows 10/11, Azure) validated by EverParse code: NVSP, RNDIS, OIDs, NDIS. 6K lines 3D spec (137 structs, 22 unions, 30 enums) verified in 82 s -> 30K lines C; <2% overhead; also eBPF-for-Windows + 3 other Windows networking areas. Guarantees memory+arithmetic safety, accept-iff-valid, non-malleability, double-fetch freedom; zero user proof effort. Rust output via Karamel; EverCBOR/EverCDDL/COSE (CCS'25, C+Rust); 3DGen (ICSE'25) LLM agents draft 3D specs from RFCs. QUIC record layer (S&P'21), TLS 1.3 messages (USENIX Sec'19), ASN.1 DER (CPP'23).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Text formats (HTTP/1.1 headers) are not its sweet spot; spec still trusted.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Strongest production existence proof for verified parsing at hyperscale.
nodes.property: parser memory safety, functional correctness, non-malleability, double-fetch freedom
nodes.tcb: 3D spec, F*, Z3, Karamel, C compiler
nodes.effort: spec only (~6K lines for 189 types); 0 proof

nodes.title: Vest (verified Rust parsers/serializers) and Verdict (verified X.509 validation), Verus, USENIX Sec'25
nodes.summary: Vest: RFC-style DSL -> Verus-verified Rust parser+serializer (round-trip, non-malleability), TLS 1.3 handshake, Bitcoin, Wasm; perf >= handwritten; crate vest 0.1.1. Verdict: end-to-end verified X.509 parsing+path building+validation with Chrome/Firefox/OpenSSL policies compiled from FOL; matches baselines on >10M CT certificates; crate verdict 0.1.0 (Jun 2025).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Research-grade crates (0.1.x), low maintenance guarantees.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Native-Rust verified parser path for HTTP/2/QUIC binary frames and mTLS cert validation exists.

nodes.title: Gap: no formally verified HTTP/1.1 (text) request parser in production
nodes.summary: Searches found no machine-proved HTTP/1.1 framing parser (CL/TE/chunked canonicality) in production Rust/C; smuggling CVEs continue (llhttp CVE-2021-22959/22960; Pingora TE/close-delimited; http4s CVE-2026-69216). Binary layers (TLS/QUIC/HTTP2 frames) have verified-parser tooling; text HTTP does not.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Absence-of-evidence from limited search; academic verified HTTP may exist (seed).
nodes.underclaim_risk: High-value fills_gap target: small (~1-3 KLOC), LLM-synthesizable proofs given a precise canonical-reject spec.

nodes.title: Cedar: Lean-proven model + differential random testing vs Rust
nodes.summary: arXiv 2407.01688: Lean models 1,673 LOC, Lean proofs 5,714 (3.4:1 proof:model), Rust prod 15,693; proofs check ~3 min; 4 bugs via proofs, 21 via DRT/PBT; DRT 6h/day/target on 4vCPU; proofs are about Lean model, Rust tied only by DRT; parsers unmodeled; DRT missed a validator non-termination bug. Release gated on model+proofs+DRT up to date. SymCert: 5 SMT policy analyses verified in 1 work day, extensions 4-8 days.
nodes.overclaim_risk: 'Verified Cedar' = verified model, not verified Rust binary.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Model-proof+DRT is cheap (proof 0.36x of Rust LOC) and caught 25 bugs.
nodes.tcb: Lean kernel, model-to-Rust conformance via testing only

nodes.title: libcrux ML-KEM: spec bugs + admitted modules hidden behind CI skips (Symbolic Software, 2026-02-12)
nodes.summary: Claimed 3 bugs: decompress rounding constant wrong in Spec.MLKEM.Math.fst; missing inverse NTT in ind_cpa_encrypt spec (commit c1935b9cf8, 2024-08-12); false lemma deserialize_12_bit_vec_lemma_bounded (commit 5f6e3c2083, 2025-03-25). Not caught because Ind_cpa in ADMIT_MODULES, serialize in SLOW_MODULES with VERIFY_SLOW_MODULES=no in all CI; lax-mode tactic tadmits. Rust code itself correct; vendor disputes broader claims.

nodes.title: Verifier unsoundness is live: Verus 131 soundness issues, Z3 unsound-unsat, Dafny 'ensures false'
nodes.summary: Verus label:soundness 131 (41 open, 90 closed) as of 2026-10-24; recent #3252 verified program panics at runtime (huge Vec), #3166 macro unary minus proves false, #3180 float equality wrong in bit_vector solver, #3029 BTreeMap spec unsound with coarse Ord (open), #3177 exec_spec trusted translations (open), #2036 decreases_when non-terminating spec (open); ~10 filed 2026-10-15..21. Z3: #11295 unsound unsat arrays (2026-10-24), #10963 unsound unsat define-fun-rec (regression 4.15.5, still 5.1.0). Dafny #6553 induction on seq proves ensures false (2026-10-01). F* #4534 Pulse GlobalVar unsound (2026-09-08). Verus is pre-1.0 rolling (release/rolling/0.2026.10.24.e3a3958).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Most bugs require unusual constructs; exploited by an LLM optimizing to pass is plausible.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Not a reason to abandon proofs: Fonseca shows verified cores still bug-free in protocol logic.

nodes.title: Spec-fidelity is the dominant residual risk (Fonseca'17, IronSpec, SpecBench, vericoding)
nodes.summary: Fonseca et al. EuroSys'17: 16 bugs in IronFleet/Verdi/Chapar, all in shims/specs/assumptions; zero in verified protocol cores (unverified systems had protocol bugs). IronSpec: 10 spec bugs across 6 verified systems. Verus-SpecBench (arXiv 2605.26457): best spec autoformalization 77.8% (Gemini 3.1 Pro), others 51-58%; LLM-as-judge misses 26% of spec failures caught by executable tests. Vericoding: ~9% specs too weak. Cedar DRT missed non-termination.

nodes.title: Rust verifier landscape status (2026-10-24)
nodes.summary: Verus (MIT, rolling pre-1.0, SMT/Z3; strongest systems record + LLM results). Kani (Apache-2.0, bounded MC, AWS, CI-scale). Creusot (LGPL-2.1, Why3, active). Prusti (now prusti/prusti org, active). Aeneas/Charon (Apache-2.0, Lean/F*/Rocq backends; SymCrypt). hax (moved to pereq-dev/hax, Apache-2.0; F*/Rocq; libcrux). Lean 4 industrial: Cedar, SampCert (AWS Clean Rooms DP, >12K proof lines, PLDI'25). Dafny industrial: AWS authz, Material Providers Library (Java/.NET/Python/Rust/Go).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Maintenance can stall; Verus breaking changes.

nodes.title: L5: verification CI gate for agent-written proofs
nodes.summary: Gate set derived from VeruSAGE cheat taxonomy, libcrux failure, Verus/Z3 soundness issues, SpecBench: (1) pin Verus release tag + its bundled Z3; nightly re-verify on next release; (2) static deny-list in proof code: assume(, admit(, #[verifier::external_body], #[verifier::external], assume_specification, axiom fns, exec_allows_no_decreases — each allowed only via a reviewed TRUSTED.toml ledger with LOC budget; (3) zero admitted/lax/skipped modules: fail CI if any module is excluded or timeouts are converted to skips; (4) spec files under CODEOWNERS with human sign-off; spec diffs never auto-merged from the same agent that writes proofs; (5) executable-spec tests: every top-level spec compiled via exec_spec and run against RFC test vectors + differential corpus (Cedar DRT / Verdict CT-log pattern); (6) mutation testing of specs (weaken/flip clause must break a test); (7) runtime-panic smoke tests even for verified code (Verus #3252); (8) track proof:code ratio and verification wall-time per crate as budgets.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Gate design is inference from evidence, untested here.
nodes.acceptance: CI red on any unlisted trust annotation, admitted module, or spec without executable test

nodes.title: Graded proof-cost estimate per component class for an agent-written Rust server
nodes.summary: See specifics. Basis: Verus ratios 1.9-7.5:1 (VeriSMo, Verus case studies, Anvil, Atmosphere); LLM completion 81% at ~$6/task on system tasks with specs given; spec authoring 51-78% correct and the dominant cost; EverParse/Vest generate proofs from specs; crypto/X.509/authz reusable.
nodes.specifics: (A) binary wire formats (HTTP/2 frames, HPACK/QPACK ints, QUIC frames, CBOR/COSE tokens): spec-only via EverParse3D/CDDL or Vest; 0 proof LOC; ~1-3 days/format spec+review; grade B. (B) crypto+TLS primitives: reuse aws-lc-rs/libcrux/HACL*/SymCrypt; cost = FFI TCB review; B. (C) X.509/mTLS validation: reuse Verdict (research 0.1.0) or treat as trusted rustls-webpki + DRT; C. (D) HTTP/1.1 canonical framing parser: Verus, ~1.5-3 KLOC exec, 2-6:1 proof, 70-85% proof obligations agent-closed, spec 1-2 weeks expert review; E/D. (E) authorization/capability core (attenuation monotonicity, no ambient authority): Lean or Verus model ~1-2 KLOC, ~3.4:1 (Cedar), days-weeks; reuse Cedar where it fits; B. (F) per-request resource budgets, connection/stream state machines, flow control: Verus state-machine + refinement 3-6:1; protocol design first in TLA+/P (weeks); agents ~60-80%; D. (G) concurrency/liveness (scheduler, reconcile loops): 6:1+, agents ~37% on inductive-invariant tasks -> expert-heavy; defer to rung-2 (model checking + DST); B for difficulty. (H) unsafe glue/async runtime/io_uring: Kani bounded harnesses (s2n-quic 112) + Miri; Verus async support immature (open issues on Futures); B. (I) storage/journal crash consistency: PoWER pattern in Verus, 3-6:1; C. (J) whole-server end-to-end functional correctness: not recommended (Ironclad/Everest-scale, team-years); B. Dollar cost of agent proof labor is small (~$5-15 per obligation; a 3 KLOC verified component plausibly $1-5K compute) vs human spec-review time which dominates.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Cost per component extrapolated from research systems by expert teams; LLM rates from late-2025 models on public benchmarks (possible contamination).
nodes.underclaim_risk: Treating 20:1 seL4 ratios or 'months per KLOC' as current would overstate cost by 5-10x for SMT-backed Rust.
nodes.llm_synthesizable: proofs yes (60-85% for safety, ~37% for liveness invariants); specs need execution-tested human review

protocol_implications: Assurance ladder should put SMT-backed auto-active Rust verification (Verus) as the default proof rung for safety properties of small security kernels; agents close ~80% of proof obligations at ~$6 each (VeruSAGE, Dec 2025), so proof labor is no longer the binding cost - specs are.
Spec fidelity is the dominant residual risk: require executable specs tested against RFC vectors and differential corpora; never accept LLM-as-judge review of specs (misses 26% of failures).

CI gate: zero assume/admit/external_body/axiom outside a reviewed TRUSTED ledger; zero admitted/lax/slow-skipped modules (libcrux lesson); separate agent roles for spec vs proof; pin verifier versions.

Do not hand-write or hand-verify crypto, X.509, or binary parsers: reuse verified aws-lc-rs/libcrux/HACL*/SymCrypt, Verdict, EverParse/Vest-generated parsers (zero proof effort, <2% overhead at Hyper-V scale).
Text HTTP/1.1 framing is an unserved verified-component gap and the best fills_gap target (small, high-impact, proofs agent-synthesizable).
Liveness/concurrency proofs stay expensive (agents 37% on inductive-invariant tasks); use TLA+/P model checking + deterministic simulation for those, Kani bounded harnesses for unsafe/async glue.
Math-prover leaderboard results (miniF2F/PutnamBench) are not evidence of software-proof capability; weight Verus/Dafny system benchmarks.

Verifier unsoundness is live (Verus 41 open soundness issues; Z3 unsound-unsat regressions); keep runtime tests and fuzzing even on verified components and list verifier+solver+rustc in the TCB ledger.
self_improvement: WebFetch cannot read ACM DL (403) or PDF binaries; downloading PDFs and running pdftotext locally recovered LOC tables (VeriSMo, EverParse slides) - add as standard tactic.
